test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. The olive tree grows slowly yet lives a long time.

B. The normal lifespan of an olive tree is 300-400 years, but olive trees as ancient as 3000 years have been discovered.

C. The olive is a well-known Mediterranean-native evergreen tree whose fruit and oil are used in cuisine and cooking.

D. As a result, the olive tree is known as the 'immortal tree' in mythology and botany.
solution:
The correct answer is **"CABD."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The paragraph discusses the olive tree, its slow growth, long lifespan, and culinary uses. So the first sentence must be C.
 
• The olive tree is known as the "immortal tree" due to its longevity. So, A follows C.
 
• The normal lifespan of an olive tree is 300-400 years, but some have been found to be as ancient as 3000 years. So B follows A.
 
• The paragraph follows a logical progression, starting with a description of the olive tree and ending with its mythological significance. So the last sentence must be D.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us discuss other options:
 
 
• Option 1 (CDAB) starts with a description of the olive tree but then jumps to its mythological significance before discussing its lifespan and culinary uses.
 
• Option 3 (DBCA) starts with the olive tree's lifespan but then jumps to its culinary uses before discussing its growth and mythological significance.
 
• Option 4 (ABCD) follows the same progression as the correct answer but with a different sentence order.
